name: Jeduthun
bio: Jeduthun was a Levite musician. After the ark was installed in Jerusalem, Jeduthun served alongside Heman and Zadok's priests at the old tabernacle in Gibeon, giving thanks to the LORD with trumpets, cymbals, and other instruments; his sons served there as gatekeepers (1 Chronicles 16:39-42). He is credited as the namesake of Psalms 39, 62, and 77.
